description.value:
In ancient days, the ballista was a fearsome weapon that could destroy empires. That was before guns though, so when Midnight Arms announced the ‘Combat Bolt Thrower’ in 2036 — a 40lbs behemoth of a ‘crossbow’ — many were baffled. Weapons publications lambasted the design, saying it was a waste of euro and time. Yet, the day of the CBT-36’s release, it sold out in 2 hours. Why? It’s a fuckin’ man-portable ballista, that’s why.

Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Poor Quality Crossbow • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Bow

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 1 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Foregrip, Reinforced String • Mods: Upsized Power

Special Features: Cannot be used to make Aimed Shots. While wielded in two hands, this weapon is considered Excellent Quality, but still jams when rolling a Critical Failure (1) on the Attack Check [Foregrip]. Requires BODY 12+ to be wielded unless Mounted [Upsized Power].

Range: Bow
Pre-installed: Foregrip, Reinforced String (effects already included in these stats)
Mods: Upsized Power

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
